    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_place</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>catch_delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_issues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_system" name="Order system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_record</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_payment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_payment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_notify_fail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_fail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_check_stock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_stock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_backorder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_inform_delay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>catch_backorder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_merge_stock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_update_inv</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_join_post</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_refund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_return</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_warehouse" name="Warehouse">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_pick</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_qc</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_par_split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_gift</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_gift</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_gift_merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_pack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_receive_returns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_inspect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_shipping" name="Shipping department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_docs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_intl</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_customs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_intl_merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_join_pack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_dispatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_split_post</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_return_label</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Customer wants to order" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_place" name="Place order" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_record" name="Record order details" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_payment" name="Process payment" />

    <bpmn:task id="task_notify_fail" name="Notify customer of failed payment" />

    <bpmn:task id="task_feedback" name="Send feedback follow-up email" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_done" name="Order completed" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_report" name="Report issues upon delivery" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_return_label" name="Send return shipping label" />
